title: ❓ FAQs About Indian Healthcare for International Patients
subtitle: Everything You Need to Know Before Traveling to India for Treatment
introduction: International patients often have many questions before choosing India for treatment. Here are the most frequently asked questions (FAQs) about healthcare, hospitals, costs, and patient services in India.

faqs.question: Are Indian hospitals safe and internationally recognized?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Yes. Many top hospitals are JCI and NABH accredited, ensuring international quality standards.

faqs.question: Do doctors in India have global experience?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Most specialists are trained in the USA, UK, Europe, or Singapore with years of experience.

faqs.question: Will there be language barriers?
faqs.answer: ✔️ No. English is widely spoken. Hospitals also provide translators for Arabic, Russian, French, and other languages.

faqs.question: Why is medical treatment so affordable in India?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Costs are 60–80% lower due to lower infrastructure and living expenses — quality is not compromised.

faqs.question: Can I get a treatment cost estimate before I travel?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Yes. You can share medical reports and receive a free cost estimate before arrival.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: ✔️ International patients can pay via credit card, debit card, bank transfer, or cash in INR/USD/EUR.

faqs.question: Do I need a visa for medical treatment in India?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Yes, you need a Medical Visa (M-Visa). Our team helps with invitation letters & documentation.

faqs.question: How long does the medical visa process take?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Usually 3–5 working days, depending on your country of origin.

faqs.question: Can a family member travel with me?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Yes. A Medical Attendant Visa is available for companions.

faqs.question: How long will I need to stay in India?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Depends on the treatment. Example: Heart Surgery (2–3 weeks), Knee Replacement (2 weeks), IVF (3–4 weeks), Cancer Therapy (4–8 weeks).

faqs.question: Is post-treatment care available after I return home?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Yes. Online consultations and follow-ups are provided.

faqs.question: Can I combine Ayurveda with modern treatments?
faqs.answer: ✔️ Absolutely. Many patients choose Ayurveda & holistic therapies for faster recovery.
